description: Change the ADMIN, EDITOR, or VIEWER role of a direct access grant or pending invitation by share ID from list_shares. Requires sharing access and returns the updated share metadata. This can expand or reduce recipient access; use invite_share for a new recipient and remove_share to revoke a grant.

id.description: Share or invitation ID returned by list_shares or invite_share, not a document, project, or recipient ID.

role.description: ADMIN grants management access, EDITOR editing access, VIEWER viewing access to the shared target.

name: update_share
title: Update Share
